description.zh:
播流域名。支持单个或批量域名查询。批量查询时多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。若参数为空，默认返回所有直播域名合并后的数据。
> - 传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限。
description.en:
The streaming domain. You can specify a single domain name or multiple domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). If this parameter is left empty, the merged data of all live streaming domains is returned by default.
> - When you specify DomainName, make sure that the specified domain names are live streaming domains and that you have the required permissions to operate on the specified domain names.

description.zh: 结束时间。需晚于起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end time. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format in UTC.

description.zh:
查询数据的时间粒度。单位：秒。取值：
- **300**（默认值）。
- **3600**。
- **86400**。

> 不传或传值不支持时，使用默认值**300**秒。
description.en:
The time granularity for querying data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:
- **300** (default).
- **3600**.
- **86400**.

> If you do not set this parameter or set it to an unsupported value, the default value **300** seconds is used.

description.zh: 运营商英文名。通过[DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~)获得，不传为所有运营商。
description.en: The name of the Internet service provider (ISP) in English. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to obtain the ISP name. If you do not set this parameter, data of all ISPs is returned.

description.zh: 区域英文名。通过[DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~)获得，不传为所有区域。
description.en: The name of the region in English. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to obtain the region name. If you do not set this parameter, data of all regions is returned.

description.zh: 起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 >支持查询最近**90**天的数据。
description.en: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format in UTC. >You can query data from the past **90** days.

title.zh: 查询直播域名流量数据
title.en: Query traffic data for live streaming domains

descriptions.zh:
- 不指定StartTime和EndTime时，默认读取过去24小时的数据。
- 本接口为监控数据接口，数据采集处理方式不同于计费，不能用于计算用量进行对账参考。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- If you do not specify StartTime or EndTime, data from the past 24 hours is returned by default.
- This is a monitoring data API. The data collection and processing method differs from that used for billing. Do not use this API to calculate usage for billing reconciliation.

## QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this API is 100 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, the API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this API at a reasonable frequency.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-domain-traffic-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --start-time 2017-12-10T14:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T15:00:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en alibaba --location-name-en tianjin --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveDomainTrafficData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn alibaba --EndTime '2017-12-10T15:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn tianjin --StartTime '2017-12-10T14:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Interval 300
